blocks.body: A disposal sends ground food into the kitchen drain. In older Skokie homes with cast iron or galvanized drains, that food can settle where the pipe is rough or narrow. Run cold water for several seconds after grinding, and keep grease out. If your kitchen drain clogs often, we can clean the line before installing a new disposal.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: Can a disposal clog my old drain line?
items.preview: It can, with the wrong foods.
items.answer: It can. Fibrous foods, grease and coffee grounds build up in older drains. Running cold water for a while after use helps.

items.q: My disposal just hums. What now?
items.preview: Turn it off. It's usually jammed.
items.answer: Turn it off and don't keep running it. Try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it still won't turn, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If it leaks from the body or is old, replace it.
items.answer: If the housing leaks or it's more than about 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: Can you install a disposal in an older kitchen?
items.answer: Usually. We may need to add an outlet and adjust the drain.

items.q: Can a disposal go on a double sink?
items.answer: Yes. It goes on one side, with both sides connected to the drain.

items.q: Can you replace a disposal the same day?
items.answer: Usually, if we have a unit that fits.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal replacement cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and the connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
